values.note: $26 per site per night; $13 for Senior/Access pass holders. A park entrance fee is charged in addition to camping fees.

fees.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('$26 - per site, per night'; 'A park entrance fee is required in addition to camping fees') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233379/rates (2026 and 2027 peak seasons, STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('Hook-ups and dump stations are not available at Oak Ridge Campground') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233379 notices ('RV Hookups. Hookups are not available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Motorhomes up to 32 ft and 12 ft high; trailers and fifth wheels up to 26 ft. 36 of the 99 catalogued sites take RVs, all back-in (catalog max vehicle length 32 ft); the rest are tent-only.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm (RV Length Limits) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233379 ('a 100-site, wooded campground') + RIDB campsite catalog for 233379 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Showers in the B loop only. A and C loop comfort stations close early November; Loop B stays open until the campground closes. Firewood not sold. Generators prohibited in all C loop sites and during quiet hours.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('Each loop has restrooms featuring sinks and flush toilets and the "B" loop restroom has showers'; 'Hook-ups and dump stations are not available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233379 notices, read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('Open: first of March to end of November'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservations only (recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777), bookable up to the day of arrival. Maximum 15 consecutive nights and 30 nights per calendar year (waiver possible at the visitor center). Max three tents and six people per site; no organized groups. Check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('Reservation Only - first of March to end of November'; 'Reservations must be made at Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233379 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 15, maxStay 30 each year, reservationCutOff 0; 'Reservation Maximum' notice), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/prwi/planyourvisit/oakridge.htm ('$13 - per site, per night - for Senior/Access pass holders'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $26/night, no hookups, recreation.gov booking and Senior/Access half price for this campground. Added reservations-only (fcfs never), 15-night max (30/yr), March 1 - Nov 30 season, 100 sites, motorhomes to 32 ft (trailers 26), all back-in, flush toilets, B-loop showers, no dump.
